note: 50 questions (25 EN, 25 AR) for the Week 3 retrieval evaluation. Every expected_document_id was checked against the actual document text, not assumed. Categories: same_language (question and its only correct answer share a language), cross_lingual (the only correct answer exists in the other language: an AR-only or EN-only topic), near_miss (a number that also appears, for a different fact, elsewhere in the corpus), absent_fact (deliberately unanswerable; expected_document_id is null and no chunk should score highly).
